$comment: Root ADR-0170. Provider agent packages an image installs: where the bytes come from and which bytes they must be, stated once. It lives in the area's config, not tools/technology-versions.contract.json, because a release carries only this subtree and scripts/ops/raon-large-files.sh reads the pin at run time to pass it to the Dockerfiles as build arguments (RAON_DEB_URL, RAON_DEB_SHA256, which have no defaults); the build checks the downloaded bytes against the sha256 before installing them. orchestration/tests/test_raon_large_files_command.py refuses a second file that restates the URL or the checksum.

raonk-2018.source: The RAON K vendor's own site. VWorld publishes only the Windows agent: its RAON configuration names no installer URL and no allowed OS, so the page's default (windows) applies on Linux (traced 2026-10-09, ADR-0170). Every file in this package is byte-identical to the agent installed on the data host in July 2026.
